body.prompt: Photoreal industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized camera, 57 x 39 x 33 mm, concept ENTROPY: light reaching a black hole. image[1] = exact block and layout, keep it: SMALL 16 mm lens ring right of centre (a quarter of the width), flash window upper left, shutter and recessed switch on top left over the grip, USB-C and microSD on the right side. Idea HAWKING BITS, all that falls in is written as bits on the horizon: the left grip is a coarse, perfectly ordered diamond knurl like image[2]; across the body it turns into raised 1 mm square pixels in an ordered checker, then random noise of mixed heights; in a wide ring round the lens it becomes a tight mosaic of tiny pixels in random black and white: maximum entropy at the horizon. Inside it a thin satin grey photon ring as in image[3] and the deep black lens. Pixel relief is the grip, missing pixels over the electronics are vent holes, a row of red pixels is the index line. image[4] = engraved tick scale, for the lens ring. Smooth islands for flash window, collared shutter, switch pocket and ports; light-pipe dots, hinged plug cover, strap anchor, shadow-gap seam. Rich functional surface detail, printable PLA. One camera centred on pure white, 3/4 front view slightly from above, soft light, sharp. --no text, logos, letters, numbers, screen, hands, strap, extra lenses, big lens barrel, screws, QR code
